artefact_overlap.note: the same patch, the same PoC body, the same root-cause statement or the same attack sequence appearing in two splits would let a model memorise an answer instead of reasoning to it

note: v2.1 adds four detectors - identical patch diff, shared fixing commit, normalised PoC body, root-cause statement, attack-sequence signature - and an explicit protocol-level isolation check.

protocol_isolation.note: a protocol name must not appear in more than one split; the held-out split has to be an unseen protocol, not unseen wording

within_split_repeats.note: repetition inside one split inflates train but does not leak across it
